# arianet_placement_group (Resource)

A placement group: servers created in it are spread over different hosts. Maps to `/cloud/v1/placement-groups`; servers join it with `arianet_server.placement_group_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "arianet_placement_group" "spread" {
  name       = "web-spread"
  datacenter = "eu-central-1"
}

resource "arianet_server" "node" {
  count              = 3
  name               = "node-${count.index}"
  datacenter         = "eu-central-1"
  plan_id            = 1
  image              = "ubuntu-24.04"
  placement_group_id = arianet_placement_group.spread.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter code. Changing it replaces the group.
- `name` (String) Name: letters, digits, dots and dashes, up to 63 characters.

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs). Lists can be filtered by them with a label selector.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project the resource is in. Defaults to the account's default project; changing it moves the resource.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `type` (String) Placement type. Only `spread` exists.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Placement group ID.
- `max_servers` (Number) How many servers the group can hold.
- `servers` (List of Number) Servers in the group.
- `status` (String) Status.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arianet_placement_group.spread 3
```
